issues.message: The MEXEM logo at the top is clipped by the canvas — only the lower portion of the wordmark is visible.
CTA label 'START INVEST)' is clipped at the right edge of the canvas; the full call-to-action text is not readable.
CTA pill extends past the right canvas edge with zero padding, violating the ≥16px breathing-room requirement.
Headline 'BUY ETFs COMMISSION FREE!' fills nearly the entire width with minimal margin to the left and top edges, creating a cramped feel at 728×90.
Because the CTA label is clipped and the logo is clipped, the headline dominates by default rather than by intentional hierarchy; the CTA fails to register as the secondary focal point.
Variant is a near-exact replica of the source, including the same clipping defects — composition and color story are preserved faithfully.

notes: Variant mirrors the source almost pixel-for-pixel, but inherits the same critical clipping problems on both the logo and the CTA, which are blocking for shipping.
